confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Skopje price levels, with no live listings or booking pages inspected. Restaurant and coffee anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is least certain, and the 3-star and hostel private-room anchors carry the widest range. Drink anchors are estimated from local beer prices, since direct cocktail and wine knowledge is weaker. The FX observation comes from an RBA exchange-rates overview result surfaced by search; I did not open the page myself, and a third-party site showed a different 16 October figure that I could not verify against rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on low-cost Balkan and Southeast European capitals with similar tourism demand and price levels (for example Sofia, Tirana, Podgorica and Sarajevo), adjusted to Skopje's local restaurant and accommodation market. Accommodation anchors assume a typical July booking, including taxes and mandatory fees.
